Method of Attack: software-based fault injection attack targeting memory writes to escalate privileges and gain remote code execution
exploiting the possibility to architecturally revert modified cache lines of guest VMs to their previous (stale) state
reverting variables used for authentication to a previous version to hijack authenticated sessions
manipulating return addresses on the stack to alter control flow of targeted programs
Discoverer: security researchers with CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
Impacted Systems: 1st Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV and SEV-ES)
2nd Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV and SEV-ES)
3rd Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV, SEV-ES, SEV-SNP)
Attack Vector: malicious hypervisor exploiting improper behavior of the INVD instruction affecting cache line write-back behavior
